sources.snippet: The flagship of Alibaba's small dense Qwen3.5 models. Independent analysis (Artificial Analysis) rated it the most intelligent model under 10B parameters at launch — roughly double the score of the next-closest sub-10B models — and the most intelligent multimodal model under 15B, leading peers on MMMU-Pro (~69%). sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.
